lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately ten vertical columns posterior to the branchial region. The blobs exhibit a semi-regular spacing with a higher concentration of smaller, denser clusters in the dorsal-anterior region transitioning to larger, more isolated nodes towards the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are present, intersecting with the horizontal rows of blobs to form a grid-like pattern. These intersections are most prominent in the mid-flank region where the vertical stripes are clearly delineated against the darker background.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible running along the upper third of the flank. They are defined by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity, with the upper surface reflecting high luminance and the lower edge casting a distinct shadow, creating a linear relief effect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately seven distinct high-luminance blobs. These are distributed primarily along the leading edge and the central-upper region of the fin's macro-mask.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small irregular notch is visible on the posterior margin of the first dorsal fin. A faint, linear horizontal marking is observable on the mid-lateral flank posterior to the primary dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: An elongated, high-luminance feature is attached to the ventral-posterior edge of the left pectoral fin, contrasting sharply with the fin's darker pigmentation.
